reason: I'd follow the page and take the free pack, but RM 2.80 a pouch is more than I pay for Whiskas on a Shopee sale, and I've never heard of this brand. After the booth is gone I'd have to order by Facebook message with no vouchers, no free shipping and no reviews to check, so I'd just stay with what I already buy.
objection: It costs more per pouch than Whiskas when I stack Shopee vouchers, and nothing here tells me why it is better for my cat.
would_change_my_mind: A listing on Shopee with a bundle deal that brings it to about RM 2.00 a pouch or less, with reviews from other buyers, and my cat actually finishing the free pack.
